dev_usage: Train-only by default (patches 2-3, type dev-exclusion, as WP-D's f47b_screen2): SPLIT_FILTER = ["train"] and dev_set.zip is never unpacked, so the adapter embeds the v4 train list, MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 and the VoxCeleb2 / VoxBlink rows only. The executed run (SPLIT_FILTER = None) also embedded the four dev lists (log: gender/Bangla 1468, no_gender/Bangla 1406, gender/English 982, no_gender/English 1008 rows); those arrays were read only by the dev scoring of t112sf0s / t112sf1s, which is now skipped by default (their FF_TRAIN_ONLY dev-exclusion). The Evaluation-list arrays come from e65xbs / e65xcs, which copy only the non-dev files of this artifact (stages/50_eval/e65xbs/stage.ipy line 7009 skips face_clipB3_(no_)gender_*). To get the executed behaviour, revert patches 2-3 (FF_TRAIN_ONLY=0 in t112s* then needs these dev-list arrays and dev_set.zip).

The fallback was never exercised by a recorded run; split keys and rows must be checked in the first smoke run (verify expect_log '6485 rows'; train is the only split).
